title: Measuring food waste
bodyMd: A grocer began selling imperfect fruit in separate bags at a lower price. In the following month the mass of discarded fruit fell by a quarter, while total fruit sales revenue stayed constant. The manager called the scheme costless. The accountant objected that staff now spent an extra hour each day sorting fruit and packing bags, but agreed that disposal charges had fallen. Neither had yet compared the value of the extra labour with the saving on disposal. The accountant recommended continuing the trial while recording both costs.
